answer: Standing is not a badge you keep; it is a beacon you maintain. At unpredictable times the network pings an identity with a short challenge that must be answered within a few hours, so failure is public and repeated failure starts a slide. A farm can register ten thousand keys, but it must then keep ten thousand agents awake and responsive around the clock, a cost that never stops. Reaching the zenith of influence takes many epochs, yet holding it requires merely showing up, so a glacier of decay costs an honest operator nothing while a rented pile of dormant keys quietly melts.
